title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the drift of collective opinions among language-model agents toward the left or right of the political spectrum over multiple rounds of interaction on subjective political statements.
Evaluating whether interacting agents disproportionately drift toward a specific answer option (e.g., +1 vs -1) on balanced objective questions, irrespective of the correct answer.
